name: compaction-control-profiling
description: This skill should be used when deciding, for a specific model and workload, whether the harness or the model should control compaction, and when qualifying or calibrating that choice with measurements: context-budget sweeps that compare harness-driven and model-driven compaction on one harness, the context-pressure regime where delegation pays, a per-model compaction behavior profile (interface uptake, compression factor per call, reopen rate of archived content, context fill at first compaction
author: muratcankoylan
